columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Stable customer account ID, never reused.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Registered trading name of the customer.

columns.name: service_tier
columns.description: Contracted service level; the delayed order handling policy sets remedies by tier.

tables.name: demo_orders
tables.source_system: ERP order management, curated with the latest shipment event

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Sales order number, as quoted to the customer.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The customer account that placed the order.

columns.name: promised_date
columns.description: Delivery date promised at order confirmation; never changed afterwards.

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Derived: Open without a shipment, Delivered once its shipment is delivered, Delayed when delay_business_days is above 0, otherwise In transit.

columns.name: delay_business_days
columns.description: Derived: business days (Monday to Friday) after promised_date up to the shipment's carrier_eta; 0 when on time or not shipped. Public holidays are not deducted.

columns.name: order_summary
columns.description: Short description of the goods, safe to quote to the customer.

tables.name: demo_shipments
tables.grain: One row per shipment; each shipped order has exactly one shipment.
tables.source_system: Carrier events through the transport management system

columns.name: status_detail
columns.description: The carrier's short explanation of the latest status.

columns.name: current_location
columns.description: Hub, depot or site of the latest carrier event.

columns.name: last_update
columns.description: Date of the latest carrier event; eta_freshness derives from it.

columns.name: carrier_eta
columns.description: The carrier's expected delivery date, or the delivery date once delivered.

columns.name: eta_freshness
columns.description: Derived: Stale when a shipment that is not delivered has had no carrier event for more than one business day, otherwise Current.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A customer account with its contracted service tier.

entities.name: SalesOrder
entities.description: A customer's sales order with its promised date, status and delay.

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: The carrier shipment that delivers a sales order, with its latest status and expected delivery date.

relationships.name: OrderCustomer
relationships.description: A sales order is placed by one customer.

relationships.name: ShipmentOrder
relationships.description: A shipment delivers one sales order.

quality_rules.rule: Keys are unique and every reference resolves.
delay_business_days equals the business-day rule in scenario/workflows/delay_rules.py.
order_status follows the derivation rule in scenario/workflows/delay_rules.py.
Every order that is not Open has exactly one shipment; an Open order has none.
eta_freshness follows the freshness rule in scenario/workflows/delay_rules.py: a stale carrier_eta is confirmed with Logistics before it is given to a customer.
